_source: 2026-09-07 live DOSBox-X (instance fin2), ch02 battle from a fixed synthesised save
_what_this_answers: worklist items 155/305 -- the AI's actually-selected command, observed at runtime rather than inferred

branches_from_decompile.0: FUN_00014ef0() first (attack attempt); if it returns non-zero the action is done, otherwise fall through to FUN_00014121() then FUN_00013e9c() (approach)
branches_from_decompile.4: no attack attempt -- DAT_00051a83 = 0 then FUN_00012d7b() directly
branches_from_decompile.5: FUN_00014ef0(), then a longer branch involving FUN_00015df3/FUN_00014b78/FUN_00025b45

enemy_pass.mode_read: unit[+0x34] = 0x00 for every one of them -> mode 0
enemy_pass.method: breakpoint at 0x13a9f (live 0x1AFA9F); at each stop the unit index was read from ESI and that unit's record+0x30 row was dumped separately, so each reading is at its own address

friendly_pass.caller: FUN_0001d80b -- identified from the return address on the stack (live 0x1B987B -> Ghidra 0x1d87b), which is inside the friendly scan, not the enemy one
friendly_pass.mode_read: unit[+0x34] = 0x04 -> mode 4 (the branch with no attack attempt)

live_observations.combat_actually_occurred: in the preceding turn of the same run, an enemy moved adjacent to a player unit, attacked, and died to the counterattack -- its record+5 bit0 (dead) was set while every player unit was still flagged acted, so the kill can only have come from a counterattack

scenario_setup_technique.why: the harness's key delivery is unreliable enough that navigating the field system ring to end a turn failed most attempts; this makes the scenario deterministic instead
scenario_setup_technique.how: the DOSBox-X debugger's `SM [seg]:[off] [val]..` writes memory directly. Used to (a) move enemy records' x,y (record+0/+1) next to a player unit and (b) set record+5 bit7 (acted) on all but one player unit, so a single UI action on the last one ends the turn through the game's own 'all acted' path
scenario_setup_technique.caution: `SR EIP <addr>` to force-call a function does NOT work -- jumping into FUN_0001d8ba without a valid return frame dropped the guest out of protected mode into real-mode BIOS (CS=F000). Set up state with SM and let the game reach the code itself.

correction_to_an_earlier_hypothesis: [0x51a8f] was proposed as the chosen-action index. It is reset to 0xff per unit and dispatches through the DAT_00051b91 table, but it stayed 0xff across every observed enemy action including ones that attacked -- so it is not the ordinary attack/move selector. The real selector is unit[+0x34] & 0xf as decoded above.
tooling_bug_found: breakpoints were first set one byte into the instruction: image_ref_scan reports the address of the matched dword, not of the instruction that contains it, so `mov eax,[0x51a8f]` at 0x1d956 was mis-derived as 0x1d957 and the breakpoint could never fire. Always disassemble from a known instruction boundary before trusting a scan-derived breakpoint address.
